text: Ɓen ɓe Malaa'ikaajo waroowo on e wallondirooɓe makko ɓen ƴettitata ruuhuuji maɓɓe, hara ko ɓe jillondirɓe e tooñirgol ko'e maɓɓe yeddugol Alla. Ɓe jebbiloo ko ɓe yankinaniiɓe maayde yanunde e maɓɓe nden, ɓe yedda keeferaaku e geddi ɗi ɓe wonunoo e mun, sikkugol ɗum nafay ɓe. Ɓe wi'a- nee ontuma: On fenay, pellet hari ko on heeferɓe yeddunooɓe. Pellet Alla no anndi ko huuwaynoɗon aduna, huunde suuɗaaki Mo e ɗum, O yoɓitoyay on ɗum.
